title: Learn English with new LangoPlay – level 1
paragraphs: We have a new version of the game LangoPlay. It is ready for you. It has three new things. They make learning easier. What are they?
First, the game has a better design. The new design is cleaner.
We also have five short videos. These videos show different parts of the game step by step. They help students understand how to play the game.
We have a better statistics section. Students can now see how many words they learned and how many words they can learn in the next chapter.
The new things help all students. LangoPlay is now easier to understand.
Try the new LangoPlay. Start to play today. You can start for free. Go to www.langoplay.com.
